$comment: Frozen consumer contract (D14-01/D14-04, one-way) for {root}/dispatch_state.json — the dispatch run-level state file written atomically (single writer under the dispatcher's state lock, tmp+os.replace) by pipeline/dispatch_core.py at every state transition (mode evidence, skip filter, claim, finalize, containment, terminal statuses). Schema v2 = the Phase 13 minimal shape EXTENDED additively with the MGPU-03 consumer fields (queue_depth, workers, failures); every v1 key (mode, run_id, status, started_at, updated_at, counts) is present unchanged, so v1 readers of counts/status see identical values. Consumers: the in-core plain-line terminal table (D14-02), the Phase 16 TUI slot 5, and gen_progress (keep-parsing obligation). SNAPSHOT INVARIANT — holds at every observed write by construction: counts.completed + counts.failed + counts.skipped + queue_depth + (number of workers whose in_flight is non-null) == counts.total. queue_depth is DERIVED (total - completed - failed - skipped - active_workers), never len(pending): a cell popped-but-not-yet-claimed transiently counts in the derived depth and moves into its worker's in_flight slot at the claim-time write, so the identity never breaks mid-transition. failures describes the CURRENT run only (fresh run_id per launch; cells skipped as already-complete never appear) and is bounded by counts.total. status vocabulary: running (initial), done (clean drain, including the drained-relaunch nothing-to-do verdict), incomplete (the CR-04 accounting refusal — a worker died with cells unaccounted). Cell keys are {model, task, seed, fraction} with fraction null for plain (non-curve) cells. Later changes to this contract are additive-only under the D14-04 same-commit discipline (schema + writer + consumer test in one commit).
